mentions.name: CtrlAssist
mentions.description: An open source Linux utility that combines multiple physical controllers into one virtual gamepad, letting players share control of a single character for collaborative, accessible PC gaming, similar to assist features on dedicated game consoles.
mentions.problem: Players such as young children and grandparents enjoy exploring story-rich games but find coordinated combat or movement control too challenging to play solo.
mentions.audience: PC gamers on Linux, especially families playing across age gaps and players who find coordinated control challenging solo.
mentions.source_excerpt: CtrlAssist – an open source project to bring more accessible, collaborative gaming to Linux! Inspired by PC gaming sessions with my own family, where both young and old relish exploring rich stories with immersive worlds (like Witcher 3, RDR3, Hogwarts Legacy, etc) but find coordinated combat or movement control too challenging to play solo, CtrlAssist lets you combine multiple controllers into one virtual gamepad, much like assist features on dedicated game consoles.
